values.review_scope: Review issue 5821 architecture/threat gate, exact 16-child ledger and terminal truth, production mTLS membership, epochs/leases/fencing, placement authority, migration/rollback, certificate/replay/partition failures, API/observability projection, and strict Runtime v2/v0.93/WP-14 non-ownership.
review_prompts: Does the architecture and threat model close every trust, identity, certificate, partition, replay, and migration boundary before implementation credit?
Are exactly 16 children concrete, nonduplicative, disjoint, terminal, and fully represented in integration evidence?
Can any partition, stale lease, cloned checkpoint, or failed migration create two authoritative owners?
Do real transport, certificate, relocation, recovery, and observability proofs use production paths rather than fixtures or receipts?
Did the program avoid Runtime v2, v0.93 governance, custom crypto, and WP-14 scope?
